**Comment**
We first identified this license in Debian copyright files. I'd argue there has been signifinant use of the license. +1 to add to SPDX.

+1 to add as well, given use in Debian.
Note that while it does contain some similar text to GPL, it is not close enough to be considered a slightly modified variant as the full name might suggest. That being said, I like/agree with `SMAIL` as the id, as I think adding `GPL` could be misleading.

Appears to pre-date GPL-1.0, while sharing common lineage with it. Shares pieces from [NGPL](https://spdx.org/licenses/preview/NGPL.html) as well as [Bison General Public License](https://ftp.eso.org/scisoft/scisoft4/sources/sm/sm2_4_2/src/bison/copying) (which apparently isn't on the SPDX list currently).

Discussed on 2024-10-24 legal team call, agreed to add. Will use "SMAIL General Public License" as name and `SMAIL-GPL` as ID in light of this apparently being based on a pre-GPL-1.0 version of GPL, and similar to NGPL for Nethack General Public License.
